subject: general
question: Bhopal gas disaster occurred in which of the following factory?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Carbide Pesticide plant.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Bhopal gas disaster** occurred in the** Union Carbide Pesticide plant in Bhopal, India.**
 
• The disaster took place on **December 2-3, 1984,** when a toxic gas leak from the plant resulted in the** deaths of thousands of people and caused long-term health effects for many others.**
 
• The disaster is considered one of the worst industrial accidents in history and led to significant changes in safety regulations and corporate responsibility.
 
• **Meghnagar Pharmachem Pvt Ltd** is a pharmaceutical company based in Madhya Pradesh, India, and was not involved in the Bhopal gas disaster.
 
• Standard Surfactants Limited is a chemical company based in Gujarat, India.
 
• Bhopal Incinerator Ltd is a waste management company based in Bhopal, India, and was not involved in the Bhopal gas disaster.
 
• On December 3 1984, more than 40 tons of methyl isocyanate gas leaked from a pesticide plant in Bhopal, India, immediately killing at least 3,800 people and causing significant morbidity and premature death for many thousands more.

***Hence, the correct option is option 3 - Union Carbide Pesticide plant.***
